title: API Security
description: Prevents replay of intercepted payment requests. Signature verification is always enabled.

nonceVerifyEnabled.label: Nonce Anti-Replay
nonceVerifyEnabled.desc: When enabled, each request nonce can only be consumed once within its TTL; duplicate submissions will be blocked.

reqTimeoutEnabled.label: Request Timestamp Window
reqTimeoutEnabled.desc: When enabled, requests whose timestamp differs from server time beyond the tolerance will be rejected.

reqTimeoutSeconds.label: Timestamp Tolerance
reqTimeoutSeconds.desc: Maximum allowed deviation (absolute, bidirectional) between request time and server time.

nonceTtlSeconds.label: Nonce TTL
nonceTtlSeconds.desc: How long the nonce is cached in Redis; duplicate requests beyond this duration will no longer be blocked.
